description:
Hi,

I hope you are doing good.

I have a job opportunity related to your profile with one of our client, please find below Job Description for your review. If you are interested and available for the following position then please send your updated resume in word format along with your contact details to discuss further.

 (Interview will be On 20th May 2017 and offers will be rolled out quickly)

Role: Technology Analyst - C#, WCF, ASP .Net, Azure (Only US Citizen, GC & GC EAD can apply)
Duration: Full TIme
Location: Redmond, WA
Mode of interview: In Person Redmond, WA office

Qualifications 
Basic 
• Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.
• At least 2 years of experience with Information technology

 Preferred 
• At least 3 years of overall software development experience with exposure to .Net encompassing following: -
• Experience in OOPs, SOLID Design principles and SDLC
• Experience in Problem Solving Analytical and Debugging Skills.
• Hands on experience working in N-Tier complex projects – web applications
• Experience in Agile SCRUM Methodology
• Experience working in .NET, C#
• Experience in Selenium
• Knowledge of CICD toolset: VSO/TFS
• The following skills would be good to have and not a must:Coded UI, Power Shell, Performance/Load Testing Experience, G11N/L10N, SQL Query.
• Experience and desire to work in a Global delivery environment


 • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
